note: The komi system evolved in professional Go starting in the 1920s (Hisekai introduced 4.5 point komi in 1922), but the specific mathematical problem of determining the 'perfect value of komi' has no documented origin date. The concept appears to have crystallized through empirical observation and practice over decades rather than being explicitly posed at a single point in time. Wikipedia article on Komi (Go) contains a 'Perfect Komi' section but does not date when this was first formulated as a theoretical problem.
